en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa narrated to us from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from `Abdullah b. Sinan. He said: I heard Aba `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) say:

There are three things that are a pride and adornment for the believer in this world and the Hereafter: (1) prayer at the last part of the night, (2) disregarding that which is in the hands of the people, and (3) wilaya of the Imam from the Family of Muhammad (s).
